notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 101 from 17 April 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/1CJQuqM89I7hWA9KYvjCop?si=arncPmZ1SseRp6Atuf1ilw) with @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects. First-choice PvE pick for Major and Boss Spec enemies in end-game content. The Other Half returns with a few new perks, so if you haven't got one yet Dares of Eternity awaits! Boost the damage with the blade perk, and then Swordmaster's Guard adds a little bit of everything useful. While Eager Edge was the unique Dares perk back in the day, it's appeared elsewhere since so Relentless Strikes is probably the more sensible first column trait perk to combine with Surrounded in the second for 35% (41.8% when enhanced) bonus damage when in a crowd. The Hot Swap origin trait is always useful for boosting charge time and guarding stats when you first swap to it. Recommended MW: Impact, with a damage boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by DMB Podcast 280 with @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvP pick for kill-chaining. Shapeable. Swords aren't necessarily a top choice for PvP, as at v6.2.5, but this does come with a very useful perk in Eager Edge to close the gap unexpectedly on an opponent. Jagged Edge adds damage, and Swordmaster's Guard gets your power attack as quickly as possible. Eager Edge is your must have in the first trait column and Vorpal Weapon is the best of a very PvE orientated set of traits in the second. Recommended MW: Impact, with a Quick Access Sling mod.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 26. PvE first-choice roll for general content. Boost damage with the Blade and Swordmaster's Guard boosts the charge rate for heavy attacks. Eager Edge is the unique Dares park that helps you with movement between attacks, and Whirlwind Strikes, Frenzy or Surrounded boosts weapon damage. Recommended MW: Impact, with a damage-boosting (Minor, Major or Taken Spec) mod.
